articles.title: High school football player in Arkansas practices with a venomous snake in his helmet
articles.description:
Animal services director Chris Davis said the player wore the helmet for nearly an hour and was fortunate he wasn't bitten.

The post High school football player in Arkansas practices with a venomous snake in his helmet appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: High school player practices with a venomous snake in his helmet for nearly an hour.
Animal services director Chris Davis confirms the player was lucky to avoid a bite.
This incident raises concerns about safety practices in youth sports across Boston.
